tasks.name: Plan, measure and report discipline deliverables
tasks.description: Keep the discipline deliverables list, measure progress by rules of credit, and report holds and change impacts to project controls.

consumes.use: deliverable numbers, titles and register status
planned IFR/IFD/IFC dates per deliverable
trends and changes to assess for discipline impact

tasks.name: Prepare mechanical input to FEL 1 equipment list and configuration screening
tasks.description: Assigns equipment types, rough sizes, materials and weights to the block-level equipment list for each configuration option.

consumes.use: options, unit capacities and main blocks per option
equipment type, count, key size parameter and material class per option
major heater/exchanger duties, column count and power demand per option
nameplate capacity and budget envelope
product slate driving column and tank count
preferred standards and vendors for equipment type selection

tasks.name: Develop mechanical design basis
tasks.description: Defines codes, design margins, corrosion allowances, sparing, driver and equipment standardisation rules for mechanical design.

consumes.use: owner engineering standards and approved vendor list
design life, sparing, design margins, winterisation
turndown, design margin philosophy, design cases
utility supply conditions (CW, steam, air) for equipment design
basic wind speed, seismic parameters, ambient min/max design temperatures
maximum sound pressure level at 1 m per equipment type
fugitive emission/LDAR and tank seal requirements affecting equipment standards

tasks.name: Select equipment materials and corrosion allowances
tasks.description: Selects base and cladding materials, corrosion allowances and PWHT/hardness requirements for each equipment item.

consumes.use: H2S, CO2, chlorides, naphthenic acid, free water, sulfur species and operating T/P per circuit
design P/T, MDMT, steam-out and vacuum conditions per equipment
material families and corrosion allowance per piping class at equipment nozzles
corrosion allowance rules and design life

tasks.name: Define rotating equipment sparing and driver selection
tasks.description: Sets the installed spare, driver type (motor, steam turbine, engine) and speed control for each rotating machine.

consumes.use: rated/normal/min flow, differential head, NPSHa, fluid properties, sparing and driver preference per machine
steam balance: availability and levels for turbine drivers
steam header conditions (P, T) for turbine drivers
system voltages, motor voltage by kW range, VFD policy
sparing philosophy and driver preferences

tasks.name: Obtain budget quotations and equipment cost data
tasks.description: Issues budget enquiries for major and long-lead equipment and compiles equipment cost, weight and delivery data for estimates.

consumes.use: service, type, duty, operating and design P/T, size, MoC recommendation per tag
approved bidders per commodity for budget enquiries
budget price, delivery, weight and main dimensions
estimate class, basis, code of accounts and due date for equipment pricing

tasks.name: Maintain mechanical equipment list
tasks.description: Keeps the master mechanical attributes for every equipment tag current through design and procurement.

consumes.use: equipment tag, service, type, duty, design P/T
running/spare, driver type and power
vessel size, design data, material, weights
exchanger type, area, weights
air cooler bays, fan power, weights
pump rated duty and driver kW
compressor type and driver kW
empty/operating weights per tag
PO number, vendor, award date
tag-to-PO line mapping

tasks.name: Perform shell-and-tube exchanger thermal and hydraulic design
tasks.description: Rates or designs shell-and-tube exchangers to fix TEMA type, geometry, area and pressure drops.

consumes.use: duty, fluid allocation, flows, in/out T, properties, fouling, allowable dP, design P/T
process EDR case as starting point: TEMA type, area, passes, fouling
tube and shell materials and corrosion allowance
plot space available at exchanger locations
maximum tube length, bundle pull and spacing rules

tasks.name: Perform air-cooled exchanger thermal design
tasks.description: Sizes air coolers for bays, bundles, fans and fan power at design ambient conditions.

consumes.use: duty, flows, properties, design air temperature, fan control, winterisation, allowable dP
process EDR air-cooler bays and fan basis
summer and winter design dry-bulb temperature, elevation
noise limit per air-cooler fan
rack routes, widths and bay spacing available for air coolers on the rack top

tasks.name: Design and specify fired heaters
tasks.description: Defines fired heater configuration, coil, burners, stack and combustion air system and prepares the API 560 datasheet.

consumes.use: absorbed duty per case, coil in/out conditions, allowable flux and film temperature, fuel composition, turndown
low-NOx burner/SCR and CEMS requirements
NOx/CO/SOx limits per source, stack height and diameter
heater and burner noise limits
DCS/SIS split and packaged control approach for BMS

tasks.name: Perform vessel and column mechanical design calculations
tasks.description: Calculates wall thicknesses, heads, nozzle reinforcement, skirt/saddle, wind and seismic loads and weights for pressure vessels and columns.

consumes.use: ID, T/T, liquid levels, nozzle schedule, internals type, design/operating conditions
design P/T, MDMT, vacuum and steam-out conditions
basic wind speed and exposure, seismic parameters
materials and corrosion allowance per component
codes and design margins

tasks.name: Specify column and vessel internals
tasks.description: Prepares tray, packing, distributor, demister and other internals specifications and support ring/manway requirements.

consumes.use: tray loading per section, flood margin, internals type and count
internals vendor hydraulic rating, tray layout and completed datasheets
shell ID and support ring elevations

tasks.name: Design storage tanks
tasks.description: Designs atmospheric and low-pressure storage tanks for shell courses, roof, seals, venting and foundation loads.

consumes.use: working/gross capacity, fill/draw rates, vapour pressure, blanketing, heating
allowable bearing pressure, predicted settlement
foam and cooling ring requirements for tanks
tank seal type and vapour control requirements
wind and seismic parameters

tasks.name: Prepare mechanical datasheets for vessels and columns
tasks.description: Issues mechanical datasheets with sketches for pressure vessels, drums and columns.

consumes.use: sketch, dimensions, design and operating conditions, nozzle duties
thicknesses, MAWP and weights
nozzle orientations, elevations, platform, ladder and davit locations
instrument connection type, size, rating, bridle arrangement on vessels

tasks.name: Prepare mechanical datasheets for exchangers
tasks.description: Issues TEMA shell-and-tube and API 661 air-cooled exchanger datasheets from thermal designs.

consumes.use: TEMA type, geometry, area, pressure drops
bays, bundles, fans, fan power
materials and corrosion allowance
instrument connections on exchangers and air-cooler vibration switch connections

tasks.name: Prepare rotating equipment datasheets
tasks.description: Issues API datasheets for pumps, compressors, blowers and their drivers.

consumes.use: pump operating cases, flows, head, NPSHa, fluid properties, solids
gas composition per case, inlet/outlet P/T, MW, k, Z, surge/turndown, control method
running/spare and driver type per machine
motor voltage by size, enclosure, efficiency and electrical requirements for driven equipment
Class/Division or Zone, gas group, T-code at equipment location
starting method and voltage dip limits for driver selection
noise limits and mitigation per machine

tasks.name: Prepare package specifications and scope split
tasks.description: Defines scope of supply, battery limits, utility demands and interface requirements for packaged units.

consumes.use: package duty, battery-limit P/T/flows, utility availability, guarantees
package boundaries shown on IFR P&IDs
package PLC requirements, interface signals, communications, SIS/F&G interfaces
DCS/SIS/F&G split and packaged unit control approach
power supply voltages and electrical requirements for vendor panels and motors
F&G and fixed fire protection philosophy for packages
emission control requirements per source for packages

tasks.name: Select seal, flush and lube oil systems
tasks.description: Selects API 682 seal plans and API 614 lube/seal oil systems and defines their piping and instrumentation for P&IDs.

consumes.use: sealing considerations, solids, vapour pressure
toxic content (H2S), flash point and fluid category
LDAR and fugitive emission requirements driving dual seals
toxicity (IDLH/ERPG) and flammability of pumped fluids
pump type, speed and seal chamber data
compressor seal and lube system scope

tasks.name: Provide mechanical input to P&IDs and HAZOP
tasks.description: Marks up P&IDs with equipment vents, drains, seal and lube systems and package boundaries, and closes mechanical HAZOP actions.

consumes.use: IFR P&IDs for mechanical markup
HAZOP-ready P&IDs for mechanical review
seal plans and auxiliary system scope to show on P&IDs
package battery limits and scope
HAZOP recommendations assigned to mechanical
mechanical IPLs (check valves, PSVs) requiring independence and testing

tasks.name: Prepare nozzle orientations and allowable nozzle loads
tasks.description: Develops nozzle orientation drawings with layout and issues allowable nozzle loads for piping stress.

consumes.use: requested nozzle angles, elevations, platform and ladder locations
critical line routing requiring nozzle relocation
nozzle schedule, sizes, ratings
shell thickness and nozzle reinforcement basis for allowable loads
instrument nozzle orientation and elevation/level range

tasks.name: Prepare equipment outline drawings, footprints and maintenance envelopes
tasks.description: Produces equipment outline dimensions, footprints and maintenance and removal envelopes for layout and modelling.

consumes.use: shell diameter, tube length, bundle pull length
bay dimensions and plot area
vessel dimensions and support type
outline dimensions from budget quotes
equipment locations and access/maintenance areas

tasks.name: Compile equipment weights and foundation loads
tasks.description: Issues equipment weights and foundation loading data to civil and structural for foundations and structures.

consumes.use: empty/operating/test weights, wind and seismic moments
exchanger empty/full weights and bundle weight
air cooler weights
pump and driver weights
compressor weights and dynamic data
load cases and combinations, required load data format

tasks.name: Prepare equipment lifting data
tasks.description: Defines lifting weights, centres of gravity and lifting lug/trunnion design for heavy and critical lifts.

consumes.use: heavy lift list, crane selection, lift sequence
lifting and tailing lug type and position, dressed lift requirements
certified weights and centre of gravity
calculated empty and dressed weights

tasks.name: Issue motor and driver electrical data
tasks.description: Provides rated motor power, voltage, starting method and VFD requirements per driven machine to electrical.

consumes.use: pump rated power and speed
compressor rated power and speed
driver type and VFD requirement
motor voltage by kW range
maximum DOL motor size per bus, motors needing soft starter/VFD

tasks.name: Prepare mechanical technical specifications
tasks.description: Writes project specifications for pressure vessels, exchangers, tanks, heaters, pumps, compressors and packages, including inspection and NDE requirements.

consumes.use: owner engineering standards and order of precedence
codes, margins, corrosion allowance rules
painting and insulation systems and PWHT/NDE rules for interface
electrical requirements section for driven-equipment specifications

tasks.name: Prepare requisition technical packages for bid
tasks.description: Assembles datasheets, specifications, VDRL and scope into requisitions for enquiry and records open holds.

consumes.use: vessel datasheets
exchanger datasheets
air cooler datasheets
pump datasheets
compressor datasheets
fired heater datasheet
internals datasheets
tank datasheets
package scope of supply
technical specifications
I&C scope and requirements for packages
instrument datasheets for vendor-supplied instruments
motor and electrical requirements for vendor scope
document and requisition numbering
reserved document and vendor document numbers
bidders list per requisition
procurement packages, sourcing route and RFQ dates

tasks.name: Issue technical queries and clarifications to bidders
tasks.description: Reviews bids for technical compliance and issues technical queries and resolves deviations with bidders.

consumes.use: technical part of each bid and TBE due date
completed datasheets, performance, outline drawings
technical deviations and exceptions
responses to technical queries

tasks.name: Prepare technical bid evaluations
tasks.description: Evaluates bids against the requisition and recommends technically acceptable bidders.

consumes.use: agreed clarifications and open deviations per bidder
revised offers
performance, power, weights and utilities
comments on vendor motor voltage, enclosure, starting and VFD compatibility
comments on package instrument lists and control offers
process acceptability of each offer (duty, performance)
SHE compliance of each package offer

tasks.name: Prepare requisitions for purchase
tasks.description: Conforms the requisition to the selected bidder's clarified offer for placement of the purchase order.

consumes.use: selected bidder and accepted deviations
agreed clarifications to incorporate
commercial ranking
recommended vendor

tasks.name: Hold vendor kick-off meetings
tasks.description: Confirms scope, data schedule, interfaces and open holds with the vendor after purchase order award.

consumes.use: PO scope, VDRL and delivery
PO number, vendor, buyer and expeditor
vendor document numbers and planned submission dates
fabrication milestones and ex-works date
piping holds awaiting vendor data (nozzle loads, preliminary GA)

tasks.name: Review vendor drawings and data
tasks.description: Reviews and coordinates interdisciplinary comments on vendor drawings, calculations and documents and returns coded comments.

consumes.use: dimensions, nozzles, weights, lifting points
anchor bolts, static and dynamic loads
thicknesses, MAWP, allowable nozzle loads
package P&IDs
motor ratings and electrical loads
vendor instrument list and datasheets
piping comments on nozzle orientation, connections and clips
anchor bolt confirmation and load acceptance comments
comments on package P&IDs, instrument lists and panels
comments on vendor instrument data
motor data review comments
comments on vendor electrical drawings
process review code and comments on vendor performance and P&IDs
foundation dynamic analysis results to agree with the machine vendor

tasks.name: Release certified vendor data to other disciplines
tasks.description: Releases certified vendor data to piping, civil, electrical and I&C for final design once vendor documents are certified.

consumes.use: certified GA, foundation, electrical and instrument data
package I/O list and control narrative
vendor instrument list and datasheets
review code confirming certified status

tasks.name: Close requisition holds
tasks.description: Tracks and closes holds on requisitions and vendor data as design data matures.

consumes.use: open holds per requisition
process data values confirmed and hold releases
final nozzle orientations
final piping nozzle loads

tasks.name: Check piping loads against equipment nozzle allowables
tasks.description: Checks calculated piping loads against vendor or code allowables and agrees acceptance or vendor confirmation.

consumes.use: forces and moments per nozzle and load case
vendor allowable or increased nozzle loads
allowable forces and moments per nozzle

tasks.name: Review rotordynamic, torsional and pulsation studies
tasks.description: Reviews vendor lateral, torsional and acoustic/pulsation studies for compressors and critical pumps.

consumes.use: lateral and torsional analysis and pulsation study reports (vendor calculations)
CAESAR II models and supports around reciprocating machinery
piping geometry for acoustic model

tasks.name: Review and approve inspection and test plans
tasks.description: Reviews vendor ITPs and sets witness and hold points and test requirements.

consumes.use: inspection activities, acceptance criteria, hold and witness points
inspection level and assigned inspector per PO

tasks.name: Witness shop tests and factory acceptance tests
tasks.description: Witnesses performance tests, mechanical run tests, hydrotests and FATs and releases equipment for shipment.

consumes.use: test due date and location
test procedures and acceptance criteria
assigned inspector and agreed witness points
witness and hold points to attend

tasks.name: Review spare parts recommendations
tasks.description: Reviews vendor spare parts interchangeability records for commissioning, start-up and operating spares.

consumes.use: part numbers, recommended quantities, lead times per tag
spares policy, criticality and interchangeability targets

tasks.name: Review manufacturer's data books
tasks.description: Reviews final vendor data books, certificates, code stamps and manuals for completeness.

consumes.use: certified drawings, calcs, MTRs, weld maps, NDE and test records
IOM manuals
hydrotest, NDE, PMI and performance certificates
material test reports

tasks.name: Define equipment preservation and storage requirements
tasks.description: Specifies site storage and preservation requirements for mechanical equipment from receipt to commissioning.

consumes.use: storage conditions and preservation frequencies per item
logistics and receipt plan
site storage locations and preservation records

tasks.name: Review 3D model for equipment access and maintenance
tasks.description: Checks equipment placement, nozzle connections, access and removal envelopes in 3D model reviews.

consumes.use: review model and checklists by area
clashes involving equipment
review actions assigned to mechanical
maintenance and removal envelopes to verify

tasks.name: Respond to field RFIs and equipment issues
tasks.description: Answers construction RFIs, non-conformances and field changes involving mechanical equipment.

consumes.use: RFI question and markup on equipment
proposed field change on equipment
vendor findings and recommended repairs

tasks.name: Coordinate vendor site representatives
tasks.description: Plans and coordinates vendor specialist attendance for installation, alignment, internals and start-up.

consumes.use: area sequence and target dates
installation activities and dates per CWP/IWP
subsystem sequence and turnover dates
vendor representative scope and call-off dates per package
vendor site service requests and PO reference
PO site service provisions and rates

tasks.name: Provide mechanical completion and pre-commissioning input
tasks.description: Defines equipment check sheets, internals box-up, alignment and run-in requirements and supports MC walkdowns and punch.

consumes.use: system and subsystem boundaries
ITR forms and tag-type mapping
installation and run-in instructions
completed A-ITRs including alignment and installation checks
foundation and anchor bolt survey for equipment setting

tasks.name: Issue as-built equipment data for handover
tasks.description: Updates equipment datasheets and the equipment register to as-built and certified data for owner handover.

consumes.use: serial number, nameplate rating, MAWP, as-built weights
final certified data
field deviations affecting equipment
asset classes and required attributes
missing or inconsistent equipment data returned for correction

items.name: FEL 1 equipment type and size list (mechanical attributes)
items.content: Equipment tag/service, type, approximate size and duty class, base material, rough empty weight per option.

items.name: FEL 1 equipment cost factors
items.content: Factored equipment costs and weight factors per equipment type for the Class 5 estimate and screening.

items.name: Mechanical design basis
items.content: Applicable codes (ASME VIII, TEMA, API 650/610/617/661/560), design margins on P/T, corrosion allowance rules, sparing philosophy, driver preferences, wind/seismic criteria, units and standard sizes.

items.name: Equipment materials selection and corrosion allowances
items.content: Per equipment/component: base material, cladding/lining, corrosion allowance, PWHT, NACE/sour service, impact test (MDMT) requirements.

items.name: Rotating equipment sparing and driver selection list
items.content: Per machine: number running/spare, driver type, fixed or variable speed (VFD), estimated absorbed and rated power, voltage class.

items.name: Budget enquiry package
items.content: Short-form datasheets and scope for budget pricing of major equipment and packages.

items.name: Equipment cost, weight and delivery data for estimate
items.content: Per tag: budget price or factored cost, weight, delivery lead time, long-lead flag, source (quote or factored).

items.name: Mechanical equipment list
items.content: Per tag: service, type, size/rating, design P/T, material, empty/operating weight, driver power, PO number, vendor, status.

items.name: Shell-and-tube exchanger thermal design
items.content: TEMA type, shells in series/parallel, shell diameter, tube length/count/layout, area, overdesign, allowable vs calculated pressure drops, vibration check.

items.name: Air-cooled exchanger thermal design
items.content: Bays, bundles per bay, tube rows/length, fins, plot area, fans per bay, fan power, louvres, winterisation, noise per fan.

items.name: Fired heater datasheet and specification
items.content: Duty, coil passes and material, flux rates, burner type/number, fuel gas/oil conditions, stack height, efficiency, NOx, air preheat, draft.

items.name: Fired heater burner management and combustion control requirements
items.content: BMS functions, flame scanners, pilot/main fuel trips, draft and O2 control points, purge sequence and instrument requirements for I&C.

items.name: Vessel and column mechanical design calculations
items.content: Shell/head thickness, nozzle reinforcement, skirt/saddle design, wind and seismic moments, empty/operating/test weights, MAWP, hydrotest pressure.

items.name: Column and vessel internals datasheets
items.content: Tray type/spacing/passes, packing type and bed heights, distributors, demisters, vortex breakers, support rings and clips, manway sizes, materials.

items.name: Storage tank datasheets and calculations
items.content: Diameter/height, shell course thicknesses, roof type (fixed/floating), seals, annular plate, venting capacity, nozzles, appurtenances, heating coils.

items.name: Tank foundation loads and settlement criteria
items.content: Shell and bottom loads (empty/operating/hydrotest), wind/seismic overturning, anchorage, allowable differential and edge settlement, ringwall requirements.

items.name: Vessel and column mechanical datasheets
items.content: Sketch, nozzle schedule with size/rating/facing, design P/T, MAWP, materials, CA, PWHT, insulation, internals reference, weights, NDE extent.

items.name: Shell-and-tube exchanger datasheets (TEMA)
items.content: TEMA type, thermal results, design P/T both sides, materials, CA, nozzle sizes/ratings, weights empty/full/bundle, setting plan.

items.name: Air-cooled exchanger datasheets (API 661)
items.content: Thermal results, header type, tube/fin materials, fans and drivers, louvres, structure, walkways, weights, noise.

items.name: Pump datasheets (API 610 / ASME)
items.content: Rated flow/head, NPSHA, fluid properties, pump type (OH/BB/VS), seal and flush plan, materials class, driver, baseplate, nozzle sizes/ratings.

items.name: Compressor and blower datasheets (API 617/618/672/673)
items.content: Operating cases, gas composition, suction/discharge conditions, type, driver, lube/seal oil system, control (anti-surge/capacity), materials.

items.name: Package specifications and scope-of-supply split
items.content: Package function, scope of supply, terminal points, design data, controls philosophy (vendor PLC vs DCS), skid limits, required documentation.

items.name: Equipment and package utility consumption data
items.content: Cooling water, steam, instrument/plant air, nitrogen, seal flush, lube oil, fuel gas demands per tag (normal/peak).

items.name: Seal plans and auxiliary system requirements
items.content: Per machine: API 682 seal arrangement and plan, barrier/buffer fluid, seal pot instruments, lube oil console scope, coolers, alarms/trips for P&ID development.

items.name: Mechanical P&ID markups
items.content: Seal plans, auxiliary piping, vent/drain nozzles, package battery limits, minimum flow/warm-up lines, equipment trim details.

items.name: Mechanical HAZOP action responses
items.content: Responses and closure evidence for HAZOP/LOPA actions assigned to mechanical (design pressure changes, seal upgrades, trips).

items.name: Nozzle orientation drawings (engineering)
items.content: Nozzle angles, elevations, projections, platform clips, davits, ladder and manway positions for vessels and columns.

items.name: Allowable nozzle loads
items.content: Per nozzle: allowable forces and moments (API 610/617/661, NEMA SM23, WRC 107/297 basis) for stress analysis.

items.name: Equipment outline drawings (preliminary GA)
items.content: Overall dimensions, nozzle positions, support type and location, skirt/saddle details for model placement.

items.name: Equipment footprints and maintenance envelopes
items.content: Footprint, height, bundle pull length, rotor/internals removal space, crane access, laydown and handling areas per tag.

items.name: Equipment weights and foundation load data
items.content: Per tag: empty, operating and test weights, wind and seismic shear and moment, bundle pull force, dynamic loads (unbalanced forces, frequencies), anchor bolt circle and number.

items.name: Equipment lifting data
items.content: Lift weight, CoG, lifting lug/trunnion locations and capacities, tailing lug, dressed vs undressed lift, shipping dimensions.

items.name: Motor and driver electrical data
items.content: Per tag: absorbed and rated power, motor rating, voltage, speed, starting method and starting limitations, VFD, space heater, duty (continuous/intermittent), load factor.

items.name: Mechanical technical specifications
items.content: Project supplements to ASME/TEMA/API codes, fabrication, NDE, PWHT, painting/insulation interface, testing, documentation and nameplate requirements.

items.name: Requisition technical package for bid
items.content: Requisition with scope, datasheets, specifications, VDRL, spare parts and inspection requirements, list of attachments.

items.name: Requisition hold list
items.content: Per requisition: open holds (design data pending, source discipline, expected date) at issue for bid and purchase.

items.name: Bidder technical query log and clarifications
items.content: Per bidder: technical queries, deviations/exceptions, responses and agreed clarifications.

items.name: Technical bid evaluation and recommendation
items.content: Compliance matrix per bidder, efficiency/power and utility evaluation, deviations accepted, technically acceptable bidders, preferred bidder.

items.name: Requisition for purchase (conformed technical package)
items.content: Updated datasheets and scope incorporating agreed clarifications, selected options, VDRL and remaining holds.

items.name: Vendor kick-off meeting minutes
items.content: Agreed VDRL and data due dates, scope clarifications, interface data needed from vendor and project, hold resolution plan.

items.name: Vendor document comment sheets (coded returns)
items.content: Consolidated comments from all disciplines with review code (approved, approved with comments, rejected) per vendor document revision.

items.name: Certified equipment GA and nozzle data
items.content: Certified dimensions, nozzle locations/sizes/ratings, support details for model update and piping final design.

items.name: Certified foundation loads and anchor bolt data
items.content: Certified loads, anchor bolt sizes and pattern, baseplate/skid details, dynamic data.

items.name: Certified vendor electrical data
items.content: Certified motor datasheets, vendor panel power loads, heater/tracing loads, vendor wiring and cable entry details.

items.name: Vendor instrument lists and package I/O
items.content: Vendor instrument index, package I/O list, serial link maps, cause and effect for package, control narratives.

items.name: Hold list status update
items.content: Hold status per requisition and vendor document, closure date, data received from source discipline.

items.name: Nozzle load acceptance and exceedance resolutions
items.content: Per nozzle: calculated vs allowable loads, acceptance, vendor-confirmed exceedances, required piping changes.

items.name: Rotordynamic and pulsation study acceptance
items.content: Accepted separation margins, required pulsation dampers/orifices, piping support requirements resulting from studies.

items.name: Approved inspection and test plans
items.content: Inspection activities, acceptance criteria, witness/hold/review points, performance and mechanical run tests, hydrotest pressures.

items.name: Shop test witness reports and release notes
items.content: Test results vs guarantees, punch items from FAT, release for shipment recommendation.

items.name: Reviewed spare parts list
items.content: Commissioning/start-up, two-year operating and capital spares per tag with quantities and interchangeability.

items.name: Manufacturer's data book acceptance
items.content: Accepted MDR with material certificates, NDE, PWHT, hydrotest records, U-stamp/nameplate, IOM manuals.

items.name: Equipment preservation requirements
items.content: Per tag: storage class (indoor/outdoor), nitrogen blanketing, shaft rotation intervals, desiccants, inspection frequency.

items.name: Equipment model review comments
items.content: Comments on equipment access, bundle/rotor removal clearances, platforms, lifting access, nozzle connection discrepancies.

items.name: Mechanical RFI responses and field change dispositions
items.content: Technical disposition of RFIs, damage, NCRs and field modifications on equipment, with markups where needed.

items.name: Vendor site service schedule and reports
items.content: Vendor attendance needed per tag and activity (installation, alignment, first fill, start-up), dates, service reports.

items.name: Mechanical equipment ITR and check requirements
items.content: Per equipment type: installation checks, alignment tolerances, internals inspection/box-up, lube flush, solo/run-in test criteria for ITR forms.

items.name: Mechanical punch items and MC acceptance
items.content: Mechanical punch items raised in walkdowns, category, and engineering acceptance of mechanical completion.

items.name: As-built equipment datasheets and equipment register
items.content: Final certified attributes per tag (vendor, model, serial, design data, materials, weights) for asset register and maintenance system.

items.name: Mechanical deliverables list
items.content: Datasheets, calculations and requisitions per equipment item with planned dates.

items.name: Mechanical progress measurement
items.content: Datasheet and requisition percent complete by rules of credit.

items.name: Mechanical change impact
items.content: Equipment affected by a trend or change, with vendor price and schedule impact.

items.name: Equipment thermal growth and nozzle flexibility
items.content: Thermal growth and nozzle displacements per equipment nozzle and nozzle flexibility data for stress analysis.

items.name: Technically acceptable bidders
items.content: Technical acceptability of proposed bidders per equipment type.
